builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Shoal Halfling lock runner, Rogue 1
traits: Neutral good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +4, size +1. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +7, Will +1. Against fear, add another +2 morale to these listed saves.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus.
Trapfinding. Sneak attack +1d6 against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or flanked by Tess. Ranged sneak attacks require a target within 30 ft. Concealment prevents sneak attack.
Climb, Jump, and Move Silently have no racial bonus. The 20-ft. land speed gives −6 to Jump. Listen retains the +2 racial bonus.
actions: Small dagger +1 melee for 1d3 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2. Above water, Small sling +5 ranged for 1d3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, range increment 50 ft. Point Blank Shot makes it +6 for 1d3+1 within 30 ft.
The sling attack includes +1 for Small size. Shoal Halflings gain no separate racial bonus with slings or thrown weapons.
builds.tactics: Tess swims through the low sluice and checks the lock from the other side. If a foe follows, she retreats to the dry step before using the sling.

builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 1 (1 class HD, LA +0).
builds.title: Shoal Halfling shoal guard, Fighter 1
traits: Lawful good. Leather armor +2, Dexterity +3, size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple −1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +3. Iron Will adds +2 to Will. Against fear, add another +2 morale to these listed saves.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus.
Weapon Focus (shortspear) is the Fighter bonus feat. The attack bonus includes +1 for Small size. Shoal Halflings gain no separate racial bonus with thrown weapons.
actions: Small shortspear +5 melee for 1d4+2 piercing, critical ×2. Thrown above water +6 for 1d4+2 piercing, range increment 20 ft.
Use the piercing melee attack underwater. The usual underwater attack and damage penalties for slashing and bludgeoning weapons do not apply to the shortspear thrust.
builds.tactics: Nerin holds the flooded arch while the crew opens the route to the sandbar. Use the shortspear in melee until everyone can surface.

concepts.name: Tess Siltstep
concepts.motive: Open the lower gate without letting the channel flood the storehouse.
concepts.hook: Tess can reach the back of the lock through the low sluice.

concepts.name: Nerin Reefbrace
concepts.motive: Hold the flooded arch until the crew reaches the sandbar.
concepts.hook: Nerin needs help opening the route while he guards the approach.
